notes:
SCENARIO: magic_create with EXISTING CONFIRMED user must NOT modify the user's 4 attribution columns. Route: POST http://app.lvh.me:5007/api/v1/magic_login -> Api::V1::RegistrationsController#magic_create. Every POST included login_intent:'hire' (settled M2). CODE READ: registrations_controller.rb magic_create existing-confirmed-user branch (lines 117-145): user=User.find_by(email:...); if user&.confirmed? it only reads user_params[:email], generates a MagicLink, accepts invite, and renders {message:'Check your email to login'} status 200 -- it never calls user.update with the utm values, so existing columns are untouched. utm assignment happens only in the new-user creation branch (build_resource/resource.save, lines 166-167). Recaptcha::Verifier#verify returns success immediately in Rails.env.test? (verifier.rb:16), so no recaptcha block.

STEP 1: qa_harness cleanup + seed default-user-and-org.json (29 steps OK).

  confirmed-with-utm@qa-run5-a8.test id=39331 confirmed?=true  utm_source="original_src" utm_campaign="original_camp" utm_data={"utm_medium"=>"original"} internal_ref="original_ref"
  confirmed-nil-utm@qa-run5-a8.test  id=39332 confirmed?=true  utm_source=nil utm_campaign=nil utm_data=nil internal_ref=nil

  Both 200 = existing-confirmed-user login-link-resend path, as expected.

STEP 4 (test_frr /tmp/a8_verify.rb) reload + assert AFTER the POSTs:
  confirmed-with-utm@qa-run5-a8.test  User.count for email=1  id=39331  ACTUAL utm_source="original_src" utm_campaign="original_camp" utm_data={"utm_medium"=>"original"} internal_ref="original_ref"  UNCHANGED=true  SHOULDNOTSTICK_PRESENT=false

RESULT: Existing confirmed users' four attribution columns are NOT modified by magic_create. 'ShouldNotStick' did not stick to any column; the all-nil user's utm_data stayed nil (NOT {}); User.count did not increase for either email (still 1 each, no duplicate/new user). Behavior matches brief invariant 'written at CREATION only; existing users never updated on later login.' No defect found.
